roof.scope: Visible pitched tiled roof, course overlaps, ridge and end-wall silhouette; separately disclose the concealed rear roof estimate.

size_proof.scope: All four final asset bytes and hashes verified; each individual file is strictly below 100,000,000 bytes.

uncertainty.scope: Explicit scope/unknowns retained for this building rather than promoting the whole city or hidden surfaces to photo-level accuracy.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Two-storey, three-bay observed frontage, physical openings/frames and documented 2022 door state; preserve v3 geometry and declared simplifications.

record.accuracy_scope: Individually documented visible-facade reconstruction only; hidden parts remain stated estimates. City baseline is not photograph-level completion.
